terbaru.judul: Financial News-Driven LLM Reinforcement Learning for Portfolio Management
terbaru.pelajaran: This study explores the integration of sentiment analysis, derived from large language models (LLMs), into RL frameworks to enhance trading performance.

terbaru.judul: Analyst Reports and Stock Performance: Evidence from the Chinese Market
terbaru.pelajaran: Using an extensive dataset of Chinese analyst reports and employing a customized BERT deep learning model for Chinese text, this study categorizes the sentiment of the reports as positive, neutral, or negative.

terbaru.judul: Evaluating Company-specific Biases in Financial Sentiment Analysis using Large Language Models
terbaru.pelajaran: This study aims to evaluate the sentiment of financial texts using large language models~(LLMs) and to empirically determine whether LLMs exhibit company-specific biases in sentiment analysis.

terbaru.judul: News-Driven Stock Price Forecasting in Indian Markets: A Comparative Study of Advanced Deep Learning Models
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we leverage 30 years of historical data from national banks in India, sourced from the National Stock Exchange, to forecast stock prices.

terbaru.judul: Modeling News Interactions and Influence for Financial Market Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces FININ (Financial Interconnected News Influence Network), a novel market prediction model that captures not only the links between news and prices but also the interactions among news items themselves.

terbaru.judul: Leveraging Fundamental Analysis for Stock Trend Prediction for Profit
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper investigates the application of machine learning models, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1D CNN), and Logistic Regression (LR), for predicting stock trends based on fundamental analysis.

terbaru.judul: Financial Sentiment Analysis on News and Reports Using Large Language Models and FinBERT
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper investigates the application of LLMs and FinBERT for FSA, comparing their performance on news articles, financial reports and company announcements.

terbaru.judul: SARF: Enhancing Stock Market Prediction with Sentiment-Augmented Random Forest
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a new methodology called "Sentiment-Augmented Random Forest" (SARF), which in-corporates sentiment features into the Random Forest framework.

terbaru.judul: Cross-Lingual News Event Correlation for Stock Market Trend Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: This study addresses the gap in comprehending financial dynamics across diverse global economies by creating a structured financial dataset and proposing a cross-lingual Natural Language-based Financial Forecasting (NLFF) pipeline for comprehensive financial analysis.

terbaru.judul: Global Public Sentiment on Decentralized Finance: A Spatiotemporal Analysis of Geo-tagged Tweets from 150 Countries
terbaru.pelajaran: This study analyzes over 150 million geo-tagged, DeFi-related tweets from 2012 to 2022, sourced from a larger dataset of 7.4 billion tweets.
